blocks.text: Review of a Registrar's decision not to extend time for the doing of a relevant act may be sought from the Administrative Review Tribunal (ART) (subsection 224(7)).

heading_path: Part 15 General Provision for Extensions of Time
Part 15.7. Review of the Registrar's decision
chunks.text: Trade Marks Act 1995 Trade Mark Regulations 1995 Review of a Registrar's decision not to extend time for the doing of a relevant act may be sought from the Administrative Review Tribunal (ART) (subsection 224(7)).

blocks.text: If the Registrar makes a decision not to extend the time, either on the basis of consideration of the application for an extension of time, or as a result of an opposition to that extension, as described above, the applicant for the extension may apply to the ART to have the decision reviewed.

heading_path: Part 15 General Provision for Extensions of Time
Part 15.7. Review of the Registrar's decision
chunks.text: If the Registrar makes a decision not to extend the time, either on the basis of consideration of the application for an extension of time, or as a result of an opposition to that extension, as described above, the applicant for the extension may apply to the ART to have the decision reviewed.

blocks.text: If there has been opposition and the Registrar allows the extension of time, the unsuccessful opponent to an extension of time of more than three months does not have a statutory right of appeal under the Trade Marks Act 1995 but may be entitled seek judicial review.
